Thrust into a universe of relentless war, become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and upgrade iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

Coming 2026 to Xbox Series X|S.
